items.title: File Widerspruch against Kinderzuschlag withdrawal/repayment decision
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Letter dated (posting day) 08.07.2026 (Wednesday). This is a Familienkasse decision on Kinderzuschlag under §48/§50 SGB X, so the general 4-day delivery-fiction rule for social-law bodies applies (§37 Abs. 2 SGB X), under which the delivery day does NOT move even if it falls on a weekend or holiday (unlike Finanzamt/§108 Abs. 3 AO cases). Counting 4 calendar days from the posting day (day of posting not counted): Jul 9 (day1), Jul 10 (day2), Jul 11 (day3), Jul 12 (day4, a Sunday) → deemed delivered 2026-07-12. The one-month Widerspruch period then runs under §26 Abs. 1 SGB X / §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of delivery is not counted, and the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day → 2026-08-12 (a Wednesday). Since that day is not a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday in NW, no shift under §26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.
